name: GroupStatusAcceptedRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to ACTC (AcceptedTechnicalValidation), ACCP (AcceptedCustomerProfile), ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess), ACSC (AcceptedSettlementCompleted) or ACWC (AcceptedWithChange), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

name: GroupStatusPendingRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to PDNG (Pending), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

name: GroupStatusRejectedRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to RJCT (Rejected), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus, if present, must be equal to RJCT (Rejected).

name: GroupStatusReceivedRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to RCVD (Received), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is not allowed.

name: SupplementaryDataRule
text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

name: StatusReasonInformationRule
text: If GroupStatus is present and is different from RJCT or PDNG then StatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation must be absent.

name: NumberOfTransactionPerStatusGuideline
text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupStatus equals 'PART'.

name: PaymentInformationStatusAcceptedRule
text: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to ACTC (AcceptedTechnicalValidation), ACCP (AcceptedCustomerProfile), ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess), ACSC (AcceptedSettlementCompleted) or ACWC (AcceptedWithChange), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

name: PaymentInformationStatusPendingRule
text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to PDNG (Pending), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

name: PaymentInformationStatusRejectedRule
text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RJCT (Rejceted), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus, if present, must be equal to RJCT (Rejected).

name: PaymentInformationStatusReceivedRule
text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RCVD (Received), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus is not allowed.

name: StatusReasonRule
text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

name: AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule
text: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

name: AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule
text: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.
